name: Shoulder
note: Schematic right shoulder, not to scale: fan-shaped muscles as outlines, the others as bellies with tendons. Positions follow standard anatomy atlases (e.g. Gray's Anatomy, 1918, public domain); shapes are simplified for teaching.

anterior-deltoid.name: Anterior deltoid
anterior-deltoid.action: Raises the arm forwards (flexion); helps press and fly

lateral-deltoid.name: Lateral deltoid
lateral-deltoid.action: Raises the arm out to the side (abduction)

posterior-deltoid.name: Posterior deltoid
posterior-deltoid.action: Pulls the arm back and out (horizontal abduction, extension)

pec-clavicular.name: Pectoralis major, clavicular head
pec-clavicular.action: Raises the arm forwards and across the body

pec-sternal.name: Pectoralis major, sternal head
pec-sternal.action: Brings the arm across and down (adduction, extension from overhead)

upper-trapezius.name: Upper trapezius
upper-trapezius.action: Lifts and upwardly rotates the shoulder blade

lower-trapezius.name: Lower trapezius
lower-trapezius.action: Pulls the shoulder blade down; helps rotate it upwards

rhomboids.name: Rhomboids
rhomboids.action: Pull the shoulder blade towards the spine

supraspinatus.name: Supraspinatus
supraspinatus.action: Starts raising the arm to the side; keeps the joint centred

infraspinatus.name: Infraspinatus
infraspinatus.action: Turns the arm outwards (external rotation); steadies the joint

teres-minor.name: Teres minor
teres-minor.action: Turns the arm outwards, with the infraspinatus

subscapularis.name: Subscapularis
subscapularis.action: Turns the arm inwards (internal rotation); steadies the joint

teres-major.name: Teres major
teres-major.action: Pulls the arm down and back, with the latissimus

latissimus.name: Latissimus dorsi
latissimus.action: Pulls the arm down and back (extension, adduction)

serratus-anterior.name: Serratus anterior
serratus-anterior.action: Holds the shoulder blade on the ribs and rotates it upwards

biceps.name: Biceps brachii
biceps.action: Bends the elbow; its long head crosses the front of the shoulder

triceps-long.name: Triceps, long head
triceps-long.action: Straightens the elbow; also pulls the arm back (crosses the shoulder)

triceps-lateral.name: Triceps, lateral head
triceps-lateral.action: Straightens the elbow (the medial head lies underneath)

views.title: Front
views.caption: Right shoulder from the front: arm on the left, chest and neck on the right.

views.title: Front, deep layer
views.caption: Pectoralis and deltoid removed: the subscapularis on the front of the shoulder blade, the serratus on the ribs.

views.title: Back
views.caption: Right shoulder from behind: spine on the left, arm on the right.

views.title: Back, deep layer
views.caption: Trapezius and deltoid removed: the rotator cuff on the shoulder blade, the rhomboids next to the spine.
